lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in four horizontal rows and approximately seven vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with inter-cluster distance increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like lattice where blobs serve as anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near its apex. A separate high-luminance irregular mark is present on the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense constellation of small, high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible across the dorsal rostrum, distinct in scale and density from the lateral flank patterning.
